workflow.title: Friday tracker status report to Rick
workflow.goal: Read the tracker export, summarise what is marked done, and list what is open and blocked, then e-mail the report to rick@summitconstruction.com. Intended to run every Friday at 16:00. The tracker has no date field, so the report covers every item in the export, not only items completed this week.

assumptions: The tracker sheet holds the export to report on; it has no date field, so no week filtering is applied and the report says so.
The every-Friday-at-4 schedule is provided by an external trigger that starts a run with input.now.
Each outbox.send to Rick requires a person's approval when the flow runs live.
risks: Items completed in earlier weeks will appear as done because the export has no dates; the report header states this.
The report is only as current as the tracker export at run time.
successCriteria: The tracker is read and every row is counted as done, open or blocked.
The report e-mail is delivered to rick@summitconstruction.com and labelled as covering all export items.
The delivered message matches the saved report hash.

nodes.description: Read every row of the tracker export.
Keep only title, status and owner of each tracker row.
Count done, open and blocked items and list the done ones.
Render one line per open item.
Render one line per blocked item.
Assemble the report text, stating that it covers all tracker export items because the export has no dates.
E-mail the status report to Rick.
Re-read the delivered message and compare its hash with the saved report.

outbox.subject: Tracker status report (all export items)
outbox.body:
